scene: You step off the gondola into Midnight Carnival.
picture: In a side-scrolling view, an open ferris wheel gondola sits on the far left. The tall Latino man with a moustache, straw hat, poncho, and guitar stands beside it. Next is a glowing fortune booth, then a carousel with horses in the centre, and an open striped tent on the far right.
shown: A glowing Zoltar-style mechanical fortune booth with red velvet curtains on the left.
A spinning carousel with painted wooden horses and brass poles in the centre.
A tall striped circus tent with a flap pinned open on the right.
